card.name: Words linking a person to what they bring
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as with, their, his, they or 's right after a person and an object or resource they bring, keep or take, in general narrative or explanatory text.

modes.label: Arriving with items
modes.description: The word 'with' after a person arrives or appears, introducing what they carry.
modes.example: He arrives at the gallery<< with>> barrels filled with the component pieces and lets

modes.label: Possessive of own belongings
modes.description: A possessive or pronoun that ties a person to something they own, keep or contribute.
modes.example: Some goalkeepers, such as Rogério Ceni and José Luis Chilavert, go forward to take<< their>> team's attacking free kicks and even penalties

card.writes: It slightly favors words about witnessing and bearing, and disfavors words about identity and borrowed items.
card.plain: It fires on little words that tie a person to the things they bring, own or keep.
